subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose restart missed-job catch-up controls in public cron config, and if so should the supported shape be global max/stagger knobs, an explicit skip/catch-up policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but new cron config changes compatibility-sensitive restart semantics for existing scheduled jobs and needs maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Expose narrow global controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

options.title: Design a skip policy instead
options.body: Use a global or per-job skip/freshness policy before implementation, preserving current catch-up defaults for existing users until the policy is explicit.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new public config and document the fixed restart catch-up behavior and operational workarounds instead.

recommendation.title: Expose narrow global controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original restart catch-up stagger work and is the strongest routing candidate for the public config/product direction choice.
